_comment: Mutation testing for packages/schemas, the second target after packages/core. Rationale: this package is rule #2's single validation source — every boundary in the app parses through it — and coverage here is already 100%, which is exactly the state where line coverage stops telling you anything. A weakened constraint (a `.min(1)` that becomes `.min(0)`, an enum member deleted, a `.uuid()` dropped) leaves every line covered and every test green while the boundary silently widens. It is also pure and I/O-free, so mutants are deterministic. packages/api is deliberately NOT next: it is I/O-shaped and slow to mutate. Run with `pnpm --filter @athanor/schemas mutation`.
_plugins_comment: Declared explicitly: Stryker's default plugin discovery globs node_modules and does not follow pnpm's symlinked layout, so the runner is installed and resolvable but not auto-loaded.
_thresholds_comment: `break` is the CI gate (.github/workflows/mutation.yml). Measured 65.21%; set to 63, never aspirationally — a threshold nobody can meet becomes a red job people learn to ignore. Ratchet UP as tests land, never down (core.md precedent, same rule as the coverage floors). `low` is kept equal to `break` so a green run does not also log an 'under low threshold' warning, which is the same desensitization by another route.
_band_comment: Why 2.2 points of slack here when packages/core runs on 0.36: the score is a ratio, so ADDING code adds to the denominator immediately and to the numerator only once tests follow. With 388 killed, `break: 63` absorbs 20 new unkilled mutants (388/615 = 63.09%) — roughly five new enum members — before it reds. Core is near-saturated and its additions are small relative to 733 mutants; this package has an open backlog and a growing vocabulary, and a gate that goes red for a blameless additive change teaches people to lower it, which is the one move forbidden here. Recompute the band, do not widen it by feel: solve killed/(total+n) >= break for n.
_baseline_comment: First run scored 62.69% against 100% line coverage. That gap IS the finding: every line of this package is executed by a test and a third of its meaning is unasserted. Five tests added in the same slice took it to 65.21% by closing the three constraint holes the report exposed — a physical event with only ONE of lat/long (both existing tests nulled the pair, where `||` and `&&` agree), a link merely CONTAINING http:// rather than starting with it, and an uphold verdict WITH a severity, whose accept arm was so untested that the refine could have been a constant `false` rejecting every uphold — the report_upheld/-200 path, rule #1. The remaining 207 are triaged in .scratch/testing-bar/issues/19: ~83 vocabulary members (blanking 'musica' or 'milestone_help' silently narrows a boundary), ~79 .pick()/.omit() flags (schemas.md's canonical derivation mechanism), ~20 Zod message strings deliberately left alone because user-facing copy lives in @athanor/i18n (rule #5) and Zod's internal text reaches no user.
